newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya's Gaddafi supports Zaire's Mobutu.
newsitem.headline: Libya's Gaddafi supports Zaire's Mobutu.

text.p: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi expressed support on Friday for Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko who faces a rebellion in the east of his vast and ethnically diverse country.
"The presence of President Mobutu at the head of power in Zaire is the sole guarantee for Zaire's unity," the official Libyan news agency JANA quoted Gaddafi as saying in a statement.
"If Mobutu disappears, Zaire's fate would be that of Somalia after Siad Barre and of Yugoslavia after Tito, and Zaire would therefore be a place for instability in the African continent," he added.

Mobutu last year visited Libya where he held what he called excellent talks with Gaddafi. Mobutu returned to Zaire this month after four months in Europe where he was treated for cancer. He reshuffled his government on Tuesday.
